title: Expose crash-disabled and generation health in plugin status/list output
description:
## Finding

`plugin list` reports configuration/install state but omits a plugin disabled after crashes or its live generation health. Operators cannot distinguish healthy, stopped, crash-loop-suppressed, or stale runtime state.

## Evidence at audited commit

`crates/thegn-host/src/cmd/plugin.rs:99` and resident plugin supervision state.

## Implementation constraints

Read a single authoritative supervisor snapshot; do not infer health from config files or process existence alone.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] CLI/control status distinguishes disabled-by-config, starting, healthy, degraded, crash-disabled, stopped, and stale generation.
- [ ] Output includes bounded/redacted last failure and restart/backoff metadata.
- [ ] Machine-readable and human output use stable state names and exit semantics.
- [ ] State survives/reconciles daemon restart according to documented policy.
- [ ] Tests drive crashes/backoff/reload/disable and assert status transitions.

## Execution dependencies

Blocked by THE-165 (UNLANDED).
